benefits: University of Saskatchewan International Excellence Award: $10,000, number offered: 1, automatic consideration on admission
International Baccalaureate (IB) Excellence Award for international students: $20,000, number offered: 1, automatic on admission
International student from Saskatchewan award: $15,000, number offered: 4, for temporary residents applying from Saskatchewan high schools, admission deadline 1 May
International student from Manitoba award: $10,000, for a top international student applying from a Manitoba high school, admission deadline 1 May
International student from Alberta award: $10,000, for a top international student applying from an Alberta high school, admission deadline 1 May
International student from British Columbia award: $10,000, for a top international student applying from a British Columbia high school, admission deadline 1 May
Indigenous students from USA awards: $10,000, number offered: 2, for Indigenous students from the United States, with Indigenous membership verification required
Separate IB Diploma Programme Excellence Award for domestic students: $3,000, which is a distinct award and not applicable to international applicants

Competitive Entrance Awards, which require a separate application and include renewable prestige awards such as the George and Marsha Ivany President's First and Best Scholarships at $40,000 over four years and the Chancellors' Scholarship at $30,000 over four years

programme_detail_official.description: The University of Saskatchewan publishes a distinct set of international student entrance awards. The flagship is the International Excellence Award, worth $10,000 and offered once per year on academic achievement, considered automatically on admission provided the admission application arrives by 15 February. Separate awards exist for International Baccalaureate completers and for temporary residents applying from Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Alberta and British Columbia high schools.
programme_detail_official.coverage: Award value toward undergraduate tuition; covered expenses and period not published

application_readiness_checklist: Apply for admission by 15 February to remain eligible for consideration
Aim for the academic achievement range that wins a single annual award - this is the only published criterion
If you are a temporary resident applying from a Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Alberta or British Columbia high school, note the separate 1 May deadline for those provincial awards
If completing the IB Diploma, check the separate $20,000 IB Excellence Award, which is a different award with different terms
No separate award application is required
common_rejection_risks: Missing the 15 February admission deadline, after which the award cannot be considered
Assuming admission guarantees the award - only one is offered per year
Applying from outside the four named provinces and expecting the provincial awards, which require temporary resident status and a high school in the named province
Confusing the international IB Excellence Award at $20,000 with the domestic IB award at $3,000
Expecting a multi-year award, since no renewal term is published
estimated_uncovered_costs: Any funding beyond the single published award value
Travel, immigration and permanent residence costs
document_audit: No award-specific document checklist is published for this award
Indigenous students from the USA must verify Indigenous membership or citizenship with documentation for the separate Indigenous awards
